Phoenix I is one of the original Phoenix beachfront condo properties in Orange Beach, offering renovated 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals with direct Gulf-front views. Fully renovated in 2018, Phoenix I features modern interiors with floor-to-ceiling windows, glass doors, and private balconies designed to showcase the Gulf’s emerald waters.
